purpose: DC-01 inventory: exact public Data Cloud read/write APIs consumed by Media adapters, existing projections and ownership. PDP-0 applies with zero mapped capability IDs — none is fabricated.

com.ghatana.datacloud.memory.media.Media.role: SPI implemented by the three Media adapters so Data Cloud can request transcription/vision/multimodal work

com.ghatana.datacloud.entity.media.Class.role: tenant classification ordering used by the projector floor check

projectionOwnership.MediaSemanticObservationProjector.projec: emits an OperationalSemanticContext.SemanticObject with exact-source binding: same-tenant, exact artifact version, classification floor, required redaction evidence, provenance (source event, consent ref, artifact, source version, provider version, redaction policy) — projection validation is NOT source authentication

capabilityIds.disposition: NO_DIRECT_CAPABILITY — the adapters serve Data Cloud's SPI and consume its public entity/semantic types; no Data Cloud capability ID is claimed or fabricated

guards.noPrivateImports: adapters may only import com.ghatana.datacloud.* public contracts and Media service surfaces — never private Data Cloud internals
guards.noFabricatedCapability: no capability ID is invented; the zero-mapped disposition is explicit
guards.projectionIsNotAuth: projector structural checks never substitute for source authentication or consent adjudication
